title: Return to Network Mode does not function correctly from Change Account screen
description: When in cloud mode, clicking 'Return to Network Mode' from the 'Change Account' screen does not revert to network mode but instead returns to the current site dashboard.
steps: Open the application in Cloud Mode.
On the login screen, tap on 'Return to Network Mode'.
actual: The application returns to the current site dashboard instead of switching to network mode.
expected: Upon tapping 'Return to Network Mode', the application should switch to network mode and provide a back option to return to the current site dashboard if the user chooses not to change accounts.
